Healthcare choice shouldn't come with IRS penalties. Look at the numbers: 1.3M Americans in Health Care Sharing Ministries hit with unfair taxes just for choosing faith-based coverage. H.R. 8776 fixes this bureaucratic overreach that's been crushing families.

The fix is simple—stop the IRS from treating alternative healthcare like a crime. These sharing ministries cut out middlemen, lower costs, and let communities support each other. But Washington bureaucrats decided that wasn't "official" enough.

This isn't just about religious freedom. It's about ending a broken system where unelected officials get to pick winners and losers in healthcare. Real reform means tracking every healthcare dollar and making sure families—not bureaucrats—decide what works for them.

When government stops punishing choice, everyone wins. That's what accountability looks like.
